privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: AradExperience is the Arad city app for events, guided sights, local offers and community actions. This page explains which data we use and why.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Your name, email address and password (stored encrypted) create your account. On your phone the app only remembers your session (a token), so you don't have to sign in every time.

activity.title: What you do in the app
activity.text: We save your tickets and bookings, saved events, community action sign-ups, points earned and spent, redeemed offers and your itineraries, so you can see them any time.

location.title: Location
location.text: Location is used only when you allow it, on your phone, for the map, routes and "near me". Coordinates are sent on request to compute distances and are not stored in your account.

camera.title: Camera
camera.text: The camera only turns on when you scan a QR code (tickets, offers, actions). Images are not stored and never leave your phone.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.text: Messages you send to the assistant are processed by Anthropic (Claude) only to answer you, together with the list of public events. Don't send personal data in the chat.

storage.title: Where data is stored
storage.text: Data is stored on Amazon Web Services servers in the European Union (Stockholm). We don't sell data and don't use it for ads.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask for a copy of your data or for your account to be deleted at any time, together with the related tickets, points and sign-ups.
